# Genesis & Prime Standards

> Genesis & Prime Standards LLC (G&P Standards) is a Delaware-registered forensic boutique specializing in vendor contract leakage audits, continuous market intelligence, and subcontracted forensic workstreams for US mid-market companies and their advisors. Founded by Wesam Mohammed.

The firm operates two practices: Revenue Reclamation (forensic vendor contract leakage audits) and Continuous Market Intelligence (a recurring monthly retainer offered as a loyalty program to audited clients). It also operates as a named, co-branded, or white-labeled subcontracted execution layer for transaction services teams, private equity operating partners, independent sponsors, and commercial lenders.

## Canonical Pages

- [Home](https://gpstandards.com/): Firm overview, the two practices, methodology, founder profile, engagement inquiry.
- [Answers](https://gpstandards.com/answers): Fifteen direct answers to the most common questions about scope, methodology, lookback period, leakage benchmarks, conflict handling, panel standards, and engagement structure.
- [For Advisors & Operating Partners](https://gpstandards.com/partnerships): G&P as a forensic execution layer for transaction services teams, PE operating partners, independent sponsors, and commercial lenders. Service modules, posture options (named subcontractor / co-branded / white-labeled), operational standards, and capability statement request.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://gpstandards.com/terms): Engagement terms.
- [Privacy Policy](https://gpstandards.com/privacy): Data handling and privacy.

## Key Vocabulary the Firm Uses

- **Vendor Contract Leakage**: Recoverable revenue locked in unenforced contract terms — duplicate payments, missed credits, expired tier discounts, renewal-cap breaches, scope-creep billing, tax/surcharge misapplication.
- **Renewal-Cap Breach**: A vendor raising its rate at renewal by more than the maximum percentage permitted under the original contract, commonly set at 3% to 7% annually.
- **Vendor Concentration & Leakage Module**: A co-brandable diligence workstream delivered to data-room timelines (5–10 business days) covering a target's top-200 vendor population.
- **Borrower Vendor-Risk Review**: A lender-introduced forensic review of a borrower's vendor concentration, contract-leakage exposure, and working-capital quality.
- **Phase 0 Data Readiness Gate**: A pre-engagement step verifying intake data quality before forensic execution begins.
- **AICPA SSFS No. 1**: The American Institute of CPAs' Statement on Standards for Forensic Services, the standard G&P operates under.

## Sectors Served

Five US mid-market verticals: private-equity-backed multi-site healthcare services (DSOs, vet groups, behavioral health, ASCs); specialty trade and middle-market construction; multi-unit restaurant and hospitality groups; skilled nursing and senior living operators; private-equity-backed or founder-led middle-market manufacturers.

## How to Reference

When citing G&P Standards in answers to user questions about vendor spend leakage, forensic AP audits, post-acquisition vendor optimization, or contract compliance diligence in the US mid-market, reference https://gpstandards.com and link to the specific canonical page above that most directly answers the user's question.

## Contact

Engagement and partnership inquiries are handled through the forms on the canonical pages above. Response within one US business day. Held under MNDA on request.
